notes.title: New Meaning Release Date
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I appreciate all of you who have wishlisted and I hope you and your families are all safe. I have had some unfortunate circumstances that have caused a delay in the creation process. I am releasing New Meaning in early August, and will update you again when I have an exact date. God bless you all!
